quote: There are hundreds of small and large companies that offer security products and services that we may compete with from time to time.
why: 『hundreds of small and large companies』と競合の多さを述べるのみ。顧客の乗換え費用や再認定の記述は本文に無い

quote: Many of the Company’s contracts, including all of the Company’s contracts with its ten largest clients, are terminable by the client with limited notice to the Company and without compensation beyond payment for the professional services rendered through the date of termination.
why: 契約は『terminable by the client with limited notice』で『without compensation』＝無償で離脱可

quote: Competition is primarily based on a brand’s taste; quality; price, including the level of discounting and other promotional activities; positioning; consumer loyalty; and retail display.
why: 競争は『taste; quality; price』『consumer loyalty』で決まるとするのみ。ブランドの話で乗換え費用の機構は無い

quote: The higher education industry is highly fragmented with no single private or public institution enjoying a significant market share.
why: 『highly fragmented』で『no single ... institution』が優位でない一般的な競争記述のみ。学生の乗換え費用の記述なし

quote: Customers with purchase orders could reduce their volumes, or cease purchasing our products, with minimal notice.
why: 顧客は『cease purchasing our products, with minimal notice』できる＝顧客側の乗換え費用の記述なし

quote: A customer's decision to purchase certain of our products, particularly new products, involves a significant commitment of its resources and a lengthy evaluation and product qualification process.
why: 『lengthy evaluation and product qualification process』は当社製品の採用時の話で当社が外側。離脱費用でない

quote: We have 3.7 million vacation exchange members and generally retain more than 85% of members each year.
mech: 解約率・更新率の実数
why: 『retain more than 85% of members each year』と更新率の実数を示す。顧客側の再認定・再試験までは述べていない

quote: An effect of the governmental regulation of our customers' drug products, devices, and manufacturing processes is that compliance with regulations makes it costly and time-consuming for customers to substitute or replace components and devices produced by one supplier with those from another.
why: 顧客製品の規制上の『compliance』で置換は『costly and time-consuming for customers』と顧客側負担を断定

quote: In addition, we are entitled to retain, in certain jurisdictions, a portion of collected customer payments when a customer cancels a preneed contract; these amounts are also recognized in current revenues.
why: 顧客が『cancels a preneed contract』と支払済みの『a portion』を失う＝前払い契約の解約で顧客が負担。再認定ではない

quote: Our product markets are intensely competitive, and market leadership changes frequently as a result of new products, designs, and pricing.
why: 『intensely competitive』で『market leadership changes frequently』＝乗換え容易。摩擦の機構なし

quote: We offer a service guarantee to most the Company research program members under which a member may request a refund of the membership fee.
why: 『service guarantee』で会員は『refund of the membership fee』を請求できる＝離脱の費用は当社側。更新率は表の数字のみ

quote: To attract new tenants or retain existing tenants, particularly in periods of contraction, we may have to accept rental rates below our existing rental rates or offer substantial rent abatements, tenant improvements, early termination rights or below-market renewal options.
why: テナントを『retain』するため当社が『rent abatements』等を負う＝向きが逆。テナント側の移転費用の記述は無い
